code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Extend the longest straight diagonal run of non-background cells.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    coords = [(r, c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    # Find a diagonal direction represented by aligned cells; select color of the run.
    for dr, dc in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
        for r,c in coords:
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == grid[r][c]:
                # extend from endpoint in this direction
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == bg:
                    out[rr][cc]=grid[r][c]
                    rr+=dr; cc+=dc
                return out
    return out
'''

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Continue the longest same-color diagonal line from its endpoint.
    best = None
    for r in range(h):

        r+=dr; c+=dc
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == bg:
            out[r][c]=color; r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out
